question: A certain number of people are sitting around a round table facing the centre. S is sitting 3rd to the right of P, who is 4th to the left of Z. Only M is sitting between A and B. No other people are sitting around the table. How many people are there in total?
solution:
Given: A certain number of people are sitting around a round table facing the centre. 

1) S is sitting 3rd to the right of P, who is 4th to the left of Z. 

2) Only M is sitting between A and B. 

3) No other people are sitting around the table. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/613a7fab13b2fc57668a1f7ce83f2dd0a0ace6fe1a601054d64baec1faf0e45f.png] 

So, there are '8' people in the row.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
